the use of AM polymer tools is a viable solution for small series production, spare parts, and functional prototyping.
the additively manufactured tools are capable of manufacturing LFRP parts with sufficient quality.

additively manufactured plastic tools are capable of producing LFT parts of sufficient quality and are therefore a viable option for small series production.
